mentions.name: Cribber
mentions.description: A daily puzzle game based on crib dragging, a classical cryptanalysis technique, built as a side project while creating the cryptography learning site.
mentions.source_excerpt: As the crypto site was being built, the idea of crib dragging came up and that sounded like a fun idea for a daily puzzle game, so I built https://cribber.net/ as a side quest.
